summary: # K-Pop Meets Digital Fashion: Behind Ae-Aespa’s "Whiplash" Universe ## Introduction Hello, I'm Park Jin-beom, working on a visual creative project under the name TAGIREN. Recently, I worked on the I.E.SPA character artwork for the girl group aespa's Reflash album. Hello, I'm Yon Sanchez, a digital fashion creator and 3D artist. My work focuses on creating clothes that are realistic in visual environments. I collaborated with Jin-beom on the Reflash Universe project. ## Project Origins Two years ago, while preparing an online lecture, I aimed to explain to students how to create clothes and utilize existing asset clothing. At that time, I was searching for assets to use, and I found that Yon had a lot of professionally and systematically produced clothes. Based on Yon's designs, I wanted to demonstrate how to customize them for my students. That's when I reached out to Yon. ## Collaboration Begins I looked at Jin-beom's Instagram and thought, "Okay, this person knows what she's doing. I love her style. I want to work with her." The character artwork for I.E.SPA was uploaded to my SNS on SM Entertainment. After seeing the previous character artwork, I was fortunate to contact the studio. I was excited about the opportunity to redesign the I.E.SPA character and create the clothing. During this time, I was in touch with Yon and sent him a direct message to propose a collaboration on the I.E.SPA costume production, knowing about his excellent skills. Jin-beom quickly responded, and without much hesitation, I said, "Let's go ahead with it." ## Fluid Collaboration We connected very naturally, and I thought, "It can't get better than this." The collaboration with Yon has been very fluid, with active sharing of connections, mutual feedback, and significant support for each other. The project had a clear direction from the start, and the process was seamless. I quickly established the basic structure and then added details. Having previously collaborated with Yon several times allowed us to proceed quickly with smooth communication. ## Advancements in Technology Thanks to the advancements in simulation technology with GPU in Claw and Marvelous Designer, we were able to work faster and more efficiently. Utilizing Marvelous Designer allowed us to devote more time to concepts and detail levels, resulting in high-quality artwork. Our collaboration, facilitated by Claw and Marvelous Designer, made it easier to review files due to their compatibility. ## Future Aspirations After the I.E.SPA's Reflash Universe project, I began working with other K-pop artists. Beyond fashion and entertainment, I aspire to have a career in the gaming industry as well. My ultimate goal is to become a 3D character artist active in various sectors. I thoroughly enjoyed working on the I.E.SPA project, as it opened many doors for me in collaborations with fashion brands, the automotive industry, and other projects where I could continually learn. As a long-term dream, I wish to create my own project, but I am not in a rush. I recognize the importance of continuous learning, exploration, networking, and staying informed about trends. ## Tools of the Trade What is Claw? Claw is an essential part of my work and has become a part of my daily life. It allows me to experiment digitally with various forms. I look forward to showcasing my new projects, as I am primarily working with Marvelous Designer. The compatibility between Claw and Marvelous Designer is exceptional. While I am improving my video-making skills, I realize that Claw sets me apart from others. I acknowledge that the challenge with Claw is its impressionism, which fits into fun. To achieve my goals, I plan to consistently utilize Marvelous Designer throughout my career. I hope to continue using Claw as I progress.
